name: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze
summary: In Auberdine, Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze watches over the misty coast of Darkshore. From the upper floor of a lodge across the bridge, she tracks growing threats and directs travelers toward dangers in the wilderness.

sections.title: A Vigilant Eye in Auberdine
sections.body: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze coordinates Auberdine's defenses from across the bridge. While other Sentinels patrol Darkshore's coast and woodlands, she watches from the upper floor of a building northeast of the town inn. She keeps alert for unusual disturbances across the region. Her directions send travelers to distant places, including the Tower of Althalaxx far to the north, so threats in the shadows do not catch Auberdine unaware.

faq.q: Where can I find Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze?
faq.answer: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze is on duty in Auberdine, in Darkshore. Cross the small bridge northeast of the inn and go to the second floor of the building there.

faq.q: What is her duty in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze helps guard Auberdine by tracking dangers across Darkshore. She directs scouts and adventurers to distant outposts and strange threats, including the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: Does she have family among the night elves?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded about Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze's kin. In Auberdine, she watches over the town and sends travelers toward the Tower of Althalaxx.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the watchful discipline the Sentinels bring to Kalimdor's northern outposts, including Auberdine.
As an Alliance traveler from Teldrassil, you can look to Sentinel Starbreeze for direction toward dangers deeper in Darkshore.
